commit_sha_note: A Git commit cannot contain its own final SHA because changing this file changes the commit hash. The exact terminal branch-head SHA is reported in the worker handoff and is independently resolvable from this branch.
headline_findings: Law 38 and Whole-Spine/Long-Memory governance already required function-and-authority conservation rather than carrier fossilization.
Recent P2X failures prove accepted authority/function can survive while runnable composition fails to consume it.
R6Q falsifies any universal integration-drift theory: current-survey-country POSITION_COORDINATE authority was genuinely absent and required a new HQ authority adoption before R6S closure.
Anti-resurrection law proves some historical implementations are intentionally superseded and must not be reconnected even when surviving function/evidence remains relevant.
